description: Compute the California Code of Civil Procedure section 437c deadlines that hang off a trial date: the last day a summary judgment motion can be heard (30 days before trial), the last day to file and serve it (81 days' notice plus the service extension; electronic service made on or after January 1, 2027 adds none), and the opposition and reply dates if the motion is heard on the last possible day.

service_method.description: How the moving papers will be served. Section 437c(a)(2) sets its own extension table, which is not the same as section 1013.

name: california_summary_judgment_deadlines
title: California summary judgment deadlines
